purpose: Defines safe crop joins across TANIM source families without merging different crop labels by guesswork.

never_auto_merge: category names used as if they were a crop
auto_join.unmatched_policy: Keep the source label separate. Do not use it for cross-source calculations until it has a safe mapping.

manual_overrides.note: NCCAG provides a Vegetables layer, not a tomato-specific layer.
